instruction: Fix `byte_count` in `codec/text.py` so it counts UTF-8 bytes, not characters. Multi-byte characters (e.g. CJK) are currently under-counted because the code returns `len(text)` instead of the encoded byte length.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec/text.py b/codec/text.py
--- a/codec/text.py
+++ b/codec/text.py
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 
 def byte_count(text: str) -> int:
     """Return the number of UTF-8 bytes in ``text``."""
-    return len(text)
+    return len(to_bytes(text))
 
 
 def normalize(text: str) -> str:
